SOCIAL STUDIES — MOCK EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

----

   B. Littering in markets
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Avoiding all community work

   C. Treat Location, Position and Size of Kenya as rumours only.
   D. Say Location, Position and Size of Kenya never happens in Kenya.
